3620.title: ACP catalog discards custom reasoning choices
3620.rootCauseOneLine: Normal package tests confirm wire-accepted custom reasoning strings are dropped by fixed forward/reverse maps and propagated into the model catalog; two clean builds and 36 tests per checkout passed.
3620.proposedFix: Preserve native identities across shared contracts; requires design beyond simple-fix scope.
3620.caveats: 2026-09-30: normal frozen installs/full builds succeed (62 tasks each); five focused cases plus 31 existing tests pass in both clean same-SHA checkouts. Actual catalog and reverse mapping tested; live OpenCode, outbound selection and UI remain unverified. Historical blocked-build harness preserved.
